result.instructions: Tools for Meilisearch, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which indexes do we have, and how many documents are in each?"; "Search our products for 'waterproof jacket' under 150 and show the brands as facets."; "Show the failed indexing tasks from the last day and their error messages.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Meilisearch data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run meilisearch_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run meilisearch_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run meilisearch_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. meilisearch_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: meilisearch_get_version
tools.title: Get server version
tools.description: Get the Meilisearch version, build commit and build date of the server. Good first call to check the connection. Meilisearch API: GET /version.

tools.name: meilisearch_list_indexes
tools.title: List indexes
tools.description: List the indexes (uid, primary key, created and updated times) with paging. Meilisearch API: GET /indexes.

tools.name: meilisearch_get_index
tools.title: Get an index
tools.description: Get one index by uid: its primary key and its created and updated times. Meilisearch API: GET /indexes/{indexUid}.

indexUid.description: Index uid, for example movies (from meilisearch_list_indexes).

tools.name: meilisearch_get_index_stats
tools.title: Get index stats
tools.description: Get the document count, storage size, indexing state and the count of documents per field of one index. Meilisearch API: GET /indexes/{indexUid}/stats.

indexUid.description: Index uid, for example movies (from meilisearch_list_indexes).

tools.name: meilisearch_get_stats
tools.title: Get server stats
tools.description: Get the database size, the last update time and the document count and indexing state of every index. Meilisearch API: GET /stats.

tools.name: meilisearch_get_settings
tools.title: Get index settings
tools.description: Get all settings of one index: searchable, displayed, filterable and sortable attributes, ranking rules, synonyms, stop words and typo tolerance. Meilisearch API: GET /indexes/{indexUid}/settings.

indexUid.description: Index uid, for example movies (from meilisearch_list_indexes).

tools.name: meilisearch_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List asynchronous tasks (document additions, index changes, settings updates) with their status. Newest tasks come first by default; set reverse to true for oldest first. Use it to see what is still processing or failed. Meilisearch API: GET /tasks.

from.description: Task uid to start from (use the next value from the previous page).

reverse.description: true to list the oldest tasks first.

statuses.description: Only tasks with these statuses, for example ["failed"].

types.description: Only tasks of these types, for example ["documentAdditionOrUpdate"].

tools.name: meilisearch_get_task
tools.title: Get a task
tools.description: Get one task by uid: its status, its type, the error if it failed, and its timings. Meilisearch API: GET /tasks/{taskUid}.

taskUid.description: Task uid (from a write result or meilisearch_list_tasks).

tools.name: meilisearch_get_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List documents of one index with paging. Pick fields to return and a filter (filterable attributes only). Meilisearch API: GET /indexes/{indexUid}/documents.

indexUid.description: Index uid, for example movies (from meilisearch_list_indexes).

fields.description: Fields to return in each document.

filter.description: Filter expression, for example "year > 2000". Filterable attributes must be set on the index.

tools.name: meilisearch_get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: Get one document by its id, optionally with only some fields. Meilisearch API: GET /indexes/{indexUid}/documents/{documentId}.

indexUid.description: Index uid, for example movies (from meilisearch_list_indexes).

documentId.description: Document id, as a string (for example 1 or abc-123).

tools.name: meilisearch_search
tools.title: Search an index
tools.description: Run a typo-tolerant search in one index, with filters, sorting, facet counts and highlighting. Meilisearch API: POST /indexes/{indexUid}/search.

indexUid.description: Index uid, for example movies (from meilisearch_list_indexes).

q.description: Search text. Omit it or leave it empty to list documents by the index rules.

page.description: Page number (use with hitsPerPage instead of limit and offset).

filter.description: Filter expression, for example "genres = Action AND year > 2000". Filterable attributes must be set on the index.

sort.description: Sort rules, for example ["price:asc"]. Sortable attributes must be set on the index.

facets.description: Attributes to count values for. Facetable attributes must be set on the index.

attributesToRetrieve.description: Fields to return in each hit, for example ["title", "year"]. Default: all fields.

attributesToHighlight.description: Fields to wrap matched words in, with <em> tags.

matchingStrategy.description: How many query words a hit must contain (default last).

tools.name: meilisearch_multi_search
tools.title: Run several searches
tools.description: Run up to 20 searches over one or more indexes in one request. Each query names its index. Meilisearch API: POST /multi-search.

indexUid.description: Index uid, for example movies (from meilisearch_list_indexes).

q.description: Search text. Omit it or leave it empty to list documents by the index rules.

page.description: Page number (use with hitsPerPage instead of limit and offset).

filter.description: Filter expression, for example "genres = Action AND year > 2000". Filterable attributes must be set on the index.

sort.description: Sort rules, for example ["price:asc"]. Sortable attributes must be set on the index.

facets.description: Attributes to count values for. Facetable attributes must be set on the index.

attributesToRetrieve.description: Fields to return in each hit, for example ["title", "year"]. Default: all fields.

attributesToHighlight.description: Fields to wrap matched words in, with <em> tags.

matchingStrategy.description: How many query words a hit must contain (default last).

queries.description: The searches to run. Each item names its indexUid.

tools.name: meilisearch_create_index
tools.title: Create an index
tools.description: Create an empty index with a uid and an optional primary key. Returns a task: check it with meilisearch_get_task. Meilisearch API: POST /indexes.

uid.description: New index uid, for example movies.

primaryKey.description: Field that holds the unique document id, for example id.

tools.name: meilisearch_upsert_documents
tools.title: Add or update documents
tools.description: Add documents to an index, or update them when their id exists (fields not sent are kept). Asynchronous: returns a task. Meilisearch API: PUT /indexes/{indexUid}/documents.

indexUid.description: Index uid, for example movies (from meilisearch_list_indexes).

documents.description: Documents as JSON objects. Each needs the primary key field.

primaryKey.description: Primary key field, when the index has none yet.

tools.name: meilisearch_delete_document
tools.title: Delete a document
tools.description: Delete one document by its id. Asynchronous: returns a task. Other documents are not touched. Meilisearch API: DELETE /indexes/{indexUid}/documents/{documentId}.

indexUid.description: Index uid, for example movies (from meilisearch_list_indexes).

documentId.description: Document id, as a string (for example 1 or abc-123).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Meilisearch
prompts.description: What you can do with Meilisearch here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: search_an_index_with_filters_and_facets
prompts.title: Search an index with filters and facets
prompts.description: Run a typo-tolerant search with filters, sorting and facet counts, or run several searches in one request.

prompts.name: explore_indexes_and_their_settings
prompts.title: Explore indexes and their settings
prompts.description: List the indexes with their document counts, then read the settings of one index.

prompts.name: check_indexing_tasks
prompts.title: Check indexing tasks
prompts.description: List the recent tasks, filter for failed ones, and read the error of one task.

prompts.name: add_update_or_remove_documents
prompts.title: Add, update or remove documents
prompts.description: Add or update documents in an index, create a new index, or delete one document. Each write returns a task to check.
